attempts.prompt:
Use case: compositing. This task requires transforming the first image, which is the exact 65x67 original source card, into a high-resolution portrait while using the second image solely as the reference for the target mascot identity. The source subject is a bareheaded man in a near-profile stern pose facing image-left, featuring a bald or receding top with short grey side and back hair, grey eyebrow hair, and a short grey-dark upper-lip moustache with a clean chin. He wears a dark grey charcoal open-lapel suit, a white shirt, and a dark striped tie. The transformation must convert the human anatomy into a smooth golden-yellow compact near-round mascot head and body with green-ringed black eyes and a simple closed mouth. It is mandatory to preserve the original hair, eyebrows as actual hair, and the specific facial hair and outfit details exactly as observed. The pose, lighting, and crop must remain identical to the source. The chin-to-collar transition must be short and broad, with the original collar and shoulder line raised and refitted to meet the rounded chin immediately, ensuring no elongated yellow neck or pointed V-shaped funnel appears inside the shirt. Front collar cloth overlaps the very short broad neck base; rear collar cloth lies behind it, with coherent seam and contact shadow. The entire dark tilted frame, opaque grey backing, and the lower-right cream note with faint indistinct upper short marks must be retained with exact crop and occlusion. All clothing, backing, and subject elements must be opaque, with genuine transparency allowed only outside the complete card silhouette. Do not add readable text, extra figures, unseen awards, pocket squares, medals, or spectacles. The result must be a single asset without comparison boards.
FINAL EXACT SOURCE REQUIREMENT: Bareheaded stern head facing IMAGE-LEFT in near-profile, with source bald/receding top and short grey side/back hair, grey eyebrow HAIR and short grey-dark UPPER-LIP MOUSTACHE, clean chin. Dark grey/charcoal OPEN-lapel suit, white shirt and dark striped tie. Preserve this exact LEFT pose and original small-card lighting/crop. No cap, spectacles, beard, unseen pocket square or medals.
A compact near-round head with a distinct ROUNDED CHIN immediately meets the raised/broadened original neckline. No separate yellow neck shaft, narrow neck stalk or pointed yellow V/funnel inside the shirt. Keep original jacket lapel state and exact shirt fastening/tie. Preserve original reference identity without erasing source hair. Optical spectacle lenses over the opaque face/backing never create alpha holes. No external labels, watermark or new backdrop.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
attempts.rejection_reason: Actually viewed exact unchanged primary, full returned original PNG, pair and white/cyan/alpha, plus additional unchanged 10x nearest-pixel primary enlargement. Left-facing pose, bald/receding crown, suit/white shirt/striped tie, short broad rounded collar fit, frame/opaque backing/note and exterior-only alpha retained. Reject the clearly changed hair tone: exact primary upper-lip moustache is a distinctly DARK brown/charcoal mark under the nose, but returned moustache is bright silver/light-grey with a prominent white top; visible side/brow hair is also over-lightened. Restore dark source moustache and source dark-grey/brown side/brow hair with only small natural highlights, keeping current shape/extent, clean chin and correct pose/clothes/collar. The original owner phrase grey-dark was insufficiently explicit; preserve that sent text and append this primary-pixel correction. Opposite-facing/different larger candidates remain excluded as authority. This is a visible dark-versus-bright change, not a demand for indistinct fine engraving. Separate source-bound fullsize hair-tone repair needed, no service refusal or game result claimed.
